verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe reference-driven generation. They cite video-to-video with character reference, motion and camera-move transfer from a source video into new styles, and Luma Agents carrying style references into every asset. However, no evidence explicitly shows extracting the visual style of a reference video or image and generating new footage in that style; the documented video references transfer motion or camera, not look. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of style transfer from a reference image or video to new video footage, details on how style references work for video generation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of style fidelity.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: carrying style references, character references, and visual grounding into every asset.
